findings.message: Helm will delete CustomResourceDefinition/default/podlogs.monitoring.grafana.com. A templated custom resource definition that the new chart does not render is removed, and Kubernetes then deletes every object of that kind.
Helm will delete objects the new chart does not render: ServiceAccount/default/stageproof-rel-grafana-agent.

The CRD podlogs.monitoring.grafana.com under crds/ changed (the file is new). Plain Helm does not upgrade CRDs in that directory. helm upgrade leaves the CRD already in the cluster as it is, and CRDs are not installed on upgrade or rollback.
ClusterRole/default/stageproof-rel-grafana-agent adds rules that the current chart did not have.
Chart default `configReloader.image.registry` changed from `docker.io` to `ghcr.io` and the rendered objects differ.
Chart default `configReloader.image.tag` changed from `v0.8.0` to `v0.12.0` and the rendered objects differ.
The pod template of DaemonSet/default/stageproof-rel-grafana-agent changed at spec.template.metadata.annotations. The pods will restart. A restart is normal for an upgrade.

findings.detail: Stageproof does not read that project's upgrade notes. A skip of more than one minor version, or a new major version, is named here and does not block.
findings.message: Chart version moves from 0.27.0 to 0.44.2, skipping 16 minor versions.

findings.detail: This is the chart's declared application version. It is not a test that the registry tag exists.
findings.message: appVersion moves from v0.37.2 to v0.44.2. The image that the chart runs may change with it.

findings.detail: The render names a different image, including images on custom resources and images passed as container arguments. Whether that tag exists is a separate check.
findings.message: 2 container images changed. DaemonSet/default/stageproof-rel-grafana-agent.template.spec.containers[0] grafana-agent container moves from docker.io/grafana/agent:v0.37.2 to docker.io/grafana/agent:v0.44.2. DaemonSet/default/stageproof-rel-grafana-agent.template.spec.containers[1] config-reloader container moves from docker.io/jimmidyson/configmap-reload:v0.8.0 to ghcr.io/jimmidyson/configmap-reload:v0.12.0.

findings.detail: A rehearsal installs the chart into an empty cluster. It does not upgrade data that is already there. An empty-cluster result of 0 restarts does not mean an existing workload stayed up.
findings.message: This chart ships custom resource definitions, and the application it runs is changing. Custom resources that already exist on a real cluster are not in this check.

findings.detail: The registry or the repository is different. The tag check still asks the new repository.
